preserved_evidence_scope: The comparison, compatibility, validation, and package_validation sections below preserve the accepted 0.4.0-dev9-performance1.8-singlebridge1 evidence and are not claims about the Mole/Fly successor package.

comparison.scope: Remove active JSON Static Bridge while retaining the accepted 1.7 scheduler, motion thresholds, treasure hot-path offload, save behavior, and immediate one-time world-map prepaint.
comparison.expected_effect: Lower periodic Lua JSON/file work, remove Overlay static-file polling and JSON parsing, eliminate duplicate state reconciliation, and reduce architecture complexity. No numeric FPS gain is claimed.

preparation_environment.authoritative_windows_gate: Install.cmd must print OVERLAY_COMPILE_OK, INSTALLER_COMPILE_OK, SESSION_WATCHER_READY, and INSTALL_COMPLETE

compatibility.legacy_static_files: cleanup-only; never read or written as live state

preserved_1_7_invariants: exactly three textual LoopAsync registrations with radar/world motion mutually exclusive
cached Engine with current Controller/Pawn traversal and no retained Pawn wrapper
Overlay-owned treasure selection and save filtering
serial save refresh; no QueueRefresh ThreadPool polling chain
one hidden Invalidate()+Update() world-map prepaint and no fixed reveal delay
removed_runtime_components: Lua static JSON construction, Boss serialization, signatures, and heartbeat writes
Overlay 200 ms static-file metadata checks and JSON deserialization
Static/Motion generation compatibility and fallback merge logic
new_runtime_components: protocol-v2 27-field Motion/control record with explicit version
src/overlay/Data/WorldBossCatalog.cs for direct local nine-record catalog ownership
src/overlay/Models/OverlayModels.cs containing only BossPoint and WorldMapState
2500 ms Motion stale timeout that hides obsolete coordinates

save_refresh_bounds.database_cache_scope: in-memory exact fingerprint per db/bak sibling
save_refresh_bounds.worker_priority: managed BelowNormal plus balanced Windows background mode, best effort

compact_bridge.notification_callback_work: dirty-bit and coalesced UI signal only
compact_bridge.world_map_notifications: disabled while forced 8 ms dual-slot reader is active

successor_validation.windows_gate_status: passed in Windows PowerShell 5.1 after the final dev72 confirmed-error recovery update
successor_validation.package_audit_claim: post-build independent audit passed for ZIP decompression/CRC reads, duplicate and path safety, manifest size/hash verification, and exact ZIP-to-staging byte equality
successor_validation.in_game_status: Dev72 remains undeployed; confirmed-error automatic recovery, initial expanded-map entry, transient active-read recovery, reopen recovery, compact smoothness, F7/F8 latency, travel reset, clean shutdown, and game frame-time remain pending owner validation

important_note: Dev72 adds bounded confirmed-error automatic F8-to-F7 recovery without a fourth scheduler loop and preserves dev71 map recovery plus dev70 behavior. Temporary missing map state cannot arm the whole-runtime restart. Static/build/package gates do not prove gameplay behavior or performance.
